title: Capcom's Best Games Continue to Sell, 2026 Releases All Perform Well
summary:
Sales updates for RE Requiem, Pragmata, and Onimusha.

Capcom has provided a sales update for all of its best-selling games, as part of its second-quarter results for fiscal year 2026. And it's business as usual for the publisher: its legacy titles continue to sell strongly, and Capcom's new releases are performing well too.

Looking at its three biggest hitters for 2026, Resident Evil Requiem has now sold 8.51 million copies, Pragmata is now at 2.73 million units, and Onimusha: Way of the Sword has managed 1.78 million sales after almost two months on the market.
